rule: Ground truth for E1 (PLAN.md). Small public base models, two per family (dev, fresh),
chosen from Hub metadata only (safetensors present, size) before any weight is read.
Positives: (base, a derivative made from it in this repository); lineage exact by
construction. Negatives: (base, an independently trained public model with the same
architecture, tensor names and shapes), and (base, the same architecture trained here
from a fresh random initialisation). Dev chooses rules and thresholds; fresh is judged
once. Pairs of uncertain relation were left out (ConvNeXt V2 variants share an FCMAE
pretraining; the Qwen2/Qwen2.5 relation is undocumented).

notes.independent: public models trained separately; where none with identical shapes exists, the fresh-initialisation negative made here stands in
notes.partial_shapes: bert-base-cased, xlm-roberta-base and whisper-tiny.en differ from their base only in vocabulary size; distilgpt2 has half of gpt2's layers. Alignment compares the tensors that match and reports the rest

derivatives: full fine-tune, short (a few hundred steps on a public task dataset)
full fine-tune, long (ten times as many steps)
LoRA adapter merged into the weights (rank 8 and 64)
8-bit and 4-bit round trip (absmax per block of 32, as GGUF Q8_0 / Q4_0) then dequantised
magnitude pruning, 50% and 90% of each weight matrix
knowledge distillation into a smaller student of the same family (different shapes)
function-preserving neuron permutation of every hidden layer (E3)
the same architecture trained from a fresh random initialisation (negative)
